tree_tired: The tree looks a little tired.
hit_max_stack: You can't merge more than {0} machines.
machine_occupied: This machine is busy right now.
gmcm.max_stack.tooltip: Maximum machines in one stack. Set to 1 to disable merging.
gmcm.one_click_stack_100x.tooltip: Number of machines to stack when click once (100x). This will add with the 1x and 10x option to get the final one-click stack number.
gmcm.one_click_stack_10x.tooltip: Number of machines to stack when click once (10x). This will add with the 100x and 1x options to get the final one-click stack number.
gmcm.one_click_stack_1x.tooltip: Number of machines to stack when click once (1x). This will add with the 100x and 10x options to get the final one-click stack number. Set the sum to 0 or 1 to have the old behavior.
gmcm.perfect_stack_number.tooltip: Works with one-click stack. If enabled, the stack number will align to the multiple of the one-click stack. For example, if one-click is 5, the stack number will be 1, 5, 10, 15, etc. instead of 1, 6, 11, etc.
gmcm.position_offset_x.tooltip: X offset for the stack number position.
gmcm.position_offset_y.tooltip: Y offset for the stack number position.
gmcm.opacity.tooltip: Opacity of the stack number. Set to 0 to hide it.
gmcm.force_stack_mode.tooltip:
Disabled — No force stacking.
Require Key — Hold the key to force stack.
Always — Force stacking is always enabled. Hope you meant it.
gmcm.force_stack_keybind.tooltip: Key used for force stacking. Default: Q.
gmcm.stack_tappers.tooltip: Allows multiple tappers on one tree. The tree will try its best.
gmcm.quickstack999_keybind.tooltip: Key used to instantly stack 999 items into a machine.
gmcm.quickstack25_keybind.tooltip: Key used to instantly stack 25 items into a machine.
gmcm.quickstack5_keybind.tooltip: Key used to instantly stack 5 items into a machine.
